## Power Scheduler — day-2 operations
Start/stop decisions made by the scheduler, from Application Insights. Times are shown in Bangkok time (UTC+7). Open this workbook from the scheduler's Application Insights resource.

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions["pwrsched.event"] == "pwrsched.decision"
| extend action = tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.action"])
| where action in ("start", "stop")
| project ['Time (Bangkok)'] = datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "Asia/Bangkok"),
          Resource = tostring(split(tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.resourceId"]), "/")[-1]),
          Type     = tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.type"]),
          Action   = action,
          Result   = tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.result"]),
          ['Dry run'] = tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.dryRun"]),
          ResourceId = tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.resourceId"])
| order by ['Time (Bangkok)'] desc
content.title: Start / stop actions
content.noDataMessage: No start or stop decisions in this time range.

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions["pwrsched.event"] == "pwrsched.decision"
| extend result = tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.result"])
| where result == "failed" or result startswith "skipped"
| project ['Time (Bangkok)'] = datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "Asia/Bangkok"),
          Resource = tostring(split(tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.resourceId"]), "/")[-1]),
          Result   = result,
          Error    = tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.error"]),
          ResourceId = tostring(customDimensions["pwrsched.resourceId"])
| order by ['Time (Bangkok)'] desc
content.title: Failed or skipped
content.noDataMessage: No failed or skipped decisions in this time range.
